text: August 2026: we cleaned the paver driveway and garden paths at a large Terranora home. The pavers were stained and discoloured before we started. Afterwards the driveway was bright all the way to the garage doors, and the path to the entry looked clean and fresh.
alt: Before and after of the driveway toward garage doors. Before: Dirty, discoloured pavers with diagonal join, planter on the right and garage  in Terranora
